map.用地平衡表 使用指南: Land Use Balance Table User Guide
map.输入城市各类用地（居住、公服、道路、绿地等）面积与人口，计算用地比例与人均指标，: Enter the areas and population for each urban land category (residential, public services, roads, green space and so on), compute land ratios and per-capita indicators, and check the balance against planning standards, for regulatory planning and scheme comparison.
map.控制性详细规划编制\"用地平衡表\"：列出居住(R)、公共管理与服务(A)、商业: Preparing a 'land use balance table' for regulatory detailed planning: list the area and share of seven land categories - residential (R), public administration and services (A), commercial and business (B), industrial (M), roads (S), utilities (U), green space and squares (G).
map.校核人均建设用地 = 总用地 ×10000 ÷ 规划人口，判断是否落在城市规模标: Check per-capita construction land = total land × 10000 ÷ planned population and judge whether it falls in the city size standard range.
map.逐类校核占地比例是否落在分类标准区间（如居住用地 25%–40%、绿地 10%–: Check category by category whether the land share falls in the classification standard range (for example residential land 25%-40%, green space 10%-15%).

map.用地分类代码 R/A/B/M/S/U/G 分别代表什么？: What do the land classification codes R/A/B/M/S/U/G stand for?
map.R 居住用地、A 公共管理与公共服务、B 商业服务业设施、M 工业、S 道路与交: R residential land, A public administration and services, B commercial and business facilities, M industrial, S roads and transport facilities, U utilities, G green space and squares. These are the first-level codes of GB 50137, the 'Standard for classification of urban land use and planning of construction land'.
map.人均建设用地标准的意义？: Significance of the per-capita construction land standard?
map.它反映了规划的人均土地集约程度，是控规的核心指标之一。标准按城市规模（大/中/小: It reflects the planned intensity of per-capita land use and is one of the core indicators of regulatory detailed planning. The standard gives ranges by city size (large / medium / small cities, towns, villages); too low means crowding and too high means land waste.
